concept.title: Coverage rollup
concept.shortdesc: Every requirement gets a rollup status computed from its verification method and linked test results:

strow.stentry: Method is test and the latest results for all verifying tests pass
At least one verifying test's latest result is a fail
No fails, but a verifying test is blocked
No fails or blocks, but a verifying test has no recorded result yet
A non-test method (inspection, analysis, demonstration) marked verified on the requirement
Method is test but no test case verifies the requirement, or a non-test method not yet marked verified
The requirement has no verification method set

section.title: What the page shows
section.p: The top of the page is a row of figures, each with a small bar: Requirements traced (requirements with a way to be verified — anything but uncovered or method-missing), Verified (pass), Failing, Suspect links still waiting to be confirmed (live project only) and No test case.

Coverage by section groups the requirements by the document headings they sit under. Each row gives the section's requirement count, how much of it is traced, a bar of its rollups — pass, fail, blocked and not-run, with the untested rest as the empty track — and the pass, fail, blocked and gap counts. The legend above the table carries the totals. Click a section to list its requirements with their reference, verification method and rollup chip (and any child-project refinements); Show all requirements opens every section at once.
